category_title: Sociable adolescent with Rett Syndrome and complex medical needs
scenario_title: Transition from hydrotherapy pool to classroom
minimal_context: Evie is transitioning from the hydrotherapy pool to her chair in the classroom at 2pm.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Evie, we are back in the classroom from the hydrotherapy pool, so let's sit in your chair.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes sharp, small noises and shakes her head.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to join the class now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The noises progressively become longer and louder, and she pushes away.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to stay here in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts to cry, continuing to cry for 19 minutes while reaching and pushing away.)

task.content: Transitioning from the hydrotherapy pool to the classroom

context.social_setting: joined her class, staff member working with Evie, class teacher

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Evie joined her class... coming out of the pool
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: she started to make sharp, small noises, but these progressively became longer and louder and then she started to cry. Evie continued crying for 19 minutes.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: crying, reaching, pushing away, showing, headshakes, nods and differentiated vocalizations
